projects.title: Supervision Brain
projects.bodyText:
- An **AI-augmented risk analysis platform** for financial advisor supervision teams, built with a multi-agent architecture layered over a deterministic rule engine.
 - Six specialised agents (NRA, EDD, Report, Pattern Discovery, Rule Author, Chat) orchestrated in **FastAPI**; **Next.js** dashboard for advisors, analysis, reports, and chat.
 - Risk grading stays deterministic and auditable — AI narrates findings, drafts rules from natural language, and answers ad-hoc questions, but never overrides the rule engine's decision.
 - PDF/Excel report generation with AI-written executive summaries; JWT auth; PostgreSQL via Supabase.

projects.title: PanicPlan
projects.bodyText:
- An **AI-powered exam study scheduler** with streaming schedule generation, RAG-backed tutor chat, and adaptive rescheduling.
 - Built with **FastAPI**, **Next.js**, **LangChain LCEL**, and **Supabase pgvector**; provider-agnostic across Gemini and LM Studio.
 - PDF-to-topic extraction with **pdfplumber**; per-topic lesson and flashcard generation with race-safe caching.
 - Streaming responses with truncated-JSON recovery; exponential backoff on rate limits; per-plan RAG scoping via pgvector.

projects.title: Kanban Board
projects.bodyText:
- A **drag-and-drop** Kanban board for task management built with **React** and **TypeScript**.
 - Features board columns, card creation, editing, and deletion.
 - State management with **Zustand**; smooth animations with Framer Motion.
 - Fully responsive and accessible.
